# National Weather Service

> > The National Weather Service provides real-time weather forecasts, alerts, marine/tropical services, climate data, and community preparedness programs powered by NOAA.

Weather.gov is the official U.S. government source for weather forecasts, warnings, and hazard information operated by NOAA's National Weather Service. The site integrates multiple specialized services including marine forecasting, climate records, GIS data, and community preparedness initiatives like StormReady and SKYWARN.

## Key Topics

- National Weather Service (NWS)
- NOAA
- Weather-Ready Nation
- Severe Weather Alerts
- Emergency Preparedness
- NOAA Weather Radio
- Wireless Emergency Alerts
- SKYWARN Storm Spotters
- StormReady Certification
- TsunamiReady Program
- Marine/Tropical Services
- Forecast Maps
- Climate Data
- GIS Data Portal
- Weather Safety

## Core Weather Services

- [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov): National Weather Service homepage with forecasts, alerts, and NOAA weather data
- [National Forecast Maps](https://www.weather.gov/forecastmaps): National Weather Service forecast maps and weather data visualization tools
- [Daily Briefing](https://www.weather.gov/briefing): Daily weather briefing with forecasts, outlooks, and disaster information
- [Information Center](https://www.weather.gov/informationcenter): Weather.gov information hub with forecasts, resources, and preparedness
- [Marine, Tropical and Tsunami Services](https://www.weather.gov/marine): Marine, tropical weather, and tsunami services from National Weather Service

## Emergency Alerts & Warnings

- [NOAA Weather Radio](https://www.weather.gov/nwr): NOAA Weather Radio for emergency alerts and severe weather information
- [Weather Alerts on the Go](https://www.weather.gov/wrn/wea): Mobile weather alerts and Wireless Emergency Alerts from Weather-Ready Nation
- [Weather Safety](https://www.weather.gov/safety): Weather safety information, hazard awareness, and emergency preparedness

## Community Preparedness Programs

- [Weather-Ready Nation](https://www.weather.gov/wrn): Weather-Ready Nation program for hazard preparedness and community outreach
- [SKYWARN](https://www.weather.gov/skywarn): SKYWARN storm spotter program for severe weather reporting and community
- [StormReady](https://www.weather.gov/stormready): StormReady certification program for community storm preparedness
- [TsunamiReady®](https://www.weather.gov/tsunamiready): TsunamiReady program for tsunami preparedness and community safety

## Climate & Historical Data

- [Climate](https://www.weather.gov/wrh/climate): Climate data, past weather records, and NOAA climate resources
- [GIS Data Portal](https://www.weather.gov/gis): GIS data portal and geospatial weather information from NWS and NOAA
- [COOP Network](https://www.weather.gov/coop): Cooperative Observers network for weather data collection and citizen science
- [Weather-Related Fatality and Injury Statistics](https://www.weather.gov/hazstat): Weather-related fatality and injury statistics and hazard data archives

## Publications & Resources

- [NWS Publications](https://www.weather.gov/publications): NWS publications, newsletters, reports, and service assessments
- [Publications and Brochures](https://www.weather.gov/owlie/publication_brochures): NWS downloadable publications, brochures, and weather education materials

## Optional

- [NWS Service Change Notices](https://www.weather.gov/notification): NWS service change notices and operational announcements
